stemMarkdown: The average age of a team of 15 members is 34 years. If the captain is 49 years old, what is the average age (in years) of the remaining members? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Total age $= 15 \times 34 = 510$. Excluding the captain leaves $510 - 49 = 461$ years across $14$ members, so the average is $\dfrac{461}{14} = 32.93$.
